text:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ Review
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode reviewed by Jarrett Green on PlayStation 5, also available on Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.

"Modern Warfare 4’s DMZ mode finally puts the fun and frantic gunplay signature to Call of Duty  into a genre I fancy more than its typical PvP multiplayer. While executing missions, the semi-arcadey running and gunning mixes nicely with the vibrant exploration elements in Hajin and the rapid fire Dynamic Objectives and side ops, creating a delightfully high-tension experience that also doesn’t get too sweaty. All of the other things around it – crafting, gunsmithing, and to a larger extent the almost RPG-like skill trees for individual operators – provide little incentive to engage with them all that rigorously. This may not bode well for DMZ’s staying power as a “service” across the coming year, but in the present, it’s a strong addition to the growing list of worthwhile extraction shooters."

Why EA Chose Star Wars Over Mass Effect and Closed BioWare - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
A new report from Bloomberg claims EA had to choose between Star Wars and Mass Effect, which resulted in the closure of BioWare. EA is facing financial pressure due to the $18 billion debt it took on during the Saudi buyout. The company then only had enough budget to back one big sci-fi game, and they chose Star Wars Battlefront 3 as the safer bet. In other news, Gears of War: E-Day has moved only 400,000 copies across Xbox and PC, a relatively low number for a marquee franchise. The Verge is reporting that Game Pass is the cause of low sales, as the game was a Day One launch title for the service. And finally, Assassin's Creed Valhalla is getting a New Game Plus update six years after the game first dropped. Ubisoft says more updates are planned.

Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Phoenix Cyclops Character Guide Trailer
Get a deep dive into Phoenix Cyclops' moves in this latest trailer for the action fighting game, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls. Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC. Phoenix Cyclops will be available on November 2, and he is the first DLC character in Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, available as part of the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, included in the Digital Deluxe and Ultimate Editions. The Year 1 Character & Stage Pass and Phoenix Cyclops are also available for purchase separately.

An explosive all-rounder, Phoenix Cyclops controls the battlefield with devastating Optic Blasts, rushing attacks, and relentless close-range pressure. In this new character guide video for Phoenix Cyclops, learn how to generate Solar Shards and unleash his devastating Phoenix form, gaining incredible power at the cost of his own health.

text:
Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars - Official Ship Reveal Trailer
Take a look inside the Hail Mary in this latest trailer for Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, an upcoming mixed reality game that expands Andy Weir’s sci-fi universe. The new trailer showcases the ship's interior. A new adventure with Grace and Rocky awaits in Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, coming to PICO, Android XR, and Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3S this fall 2026.

Step into the role of Ryland Grace in an original chapter of the Hail Mary mission, with James Ortiz reprising his role as Rocky. Experience humanity’s last hope firsthand as deep space grows increasingly uncertain around them. This mixed-reality experience blends your own physical environment with the Hail Mary itself. Diagnose problems, improvise solutions and push the limits of science and engineering to keep the mission alive.
